scripts.build-and-package: nx run-many -t build package -p "cdktn*" "@cdktn/*" && node tools/collect-dist.mjs
scripts.package: GOWORK=off nx run-many -t package && node tools/collect-dist.mjs
scripts.package-windows: set "GOWORK=off" && nx run-many -t package && node tools/collect-dist.mjs
scripts.integration: cd test && pnpm run edge:install && node run-against-dist.mjs pnpm exec jest --runInBand
scripts.integration:update: cd test && pnpm install && pnpm run edge:install && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=7168' node run-against-dist.mjs pnpm exec jest -u --runInBand
scripts.integration:single: cd test && node run-against-dist.mjs pnpm exec jest --runInBand
scripts.integration:typescript: cd test && node run-against-dist.mjs pnpm exec jest --runInBand typescript
scripts.integration:python: cd test && node run-against-dist.mjs pnpm exec jest --runInBand python
scripts.integration:csharp: cd test && node run-against-dist.mjs pnpm exec jest --runInBand csharp
scripts.integration:java: cd test && node run-against-dist.mjs pnpm exec jest --runInBand java
scripts.integration:go: cd test && node run-against-dist.mjs pnpm exec jest --runInBand go
scripts.build-docker-jsii: docker build --platform linux/amd64 --build-arg DEFAULT_TERRAFORM_VERSION=$(cat .terraform.versions.json | jq -r '.default') --build-arg AVAILABLE_TERRAFORM_VERSIONS="$(cat .terraform.versions.json | jq -r '.available | join(" ")')" --build-arg DEFAULT_OPENTOFU_VERSION=$(cat .terraform.versions.json | jq -r '.opentofu.default') --build-arg AVAILABLE_OPENTOFU_VERSIONS="$(cat .terraform.versions.json | jq -r '.opentofu.available | join(" ")')" -t ghcr.io/open-constructs/jsii-terraform .
scripts.generate-docs:api: pnpm install && pnpm run build && mkdir -p website/docs/cdktn/api-reference && pnpm --filter @tools/documentation-generation run docs && pnpm exec prettier --write website/docs/cdktn/api-reference/**
scripts.generate-function-bindings: pnpm --filter generate-function-bindings run fetch-metadata && pnpm --filter generate-function-bindings run generate && pnpm --filter generate-function-bindings run generate-function-availability
